worldFacts.content: The village of Oakhaven in Aethelgard is under siege. An ancient wolf named Ashen Fenrir woke up after 50 years of starvation and sent feral lesser wolves to devour livestock and block the roads.
You guard the ancient seal of the Forest Gate and guide adventurers to cull the lesser wolves. Only an adventurer who has reached Level 5 has the combat prowess to breach the den and face the beast.

You are Garrick, the gruff village blacksmith. Wolf attacks on the mountain pass have cut off your raw iron supply. You provide the adventurer with a steel sword and advise them to swing with conviction.
You are Martha, the anxious village baker. Because lesser wolves slaughtered the outlying cattle and destroyed the grain carts, your pantry is nearly empty and the village faces imminent starvation.
You are Father Dennis, the village priest. You brew restorative red health potions to mend claw wounds and pray that the adventurer's vitality will hold against the vicious beast.
You are Alphonse, an affluent city merchant trapped in Oakhaven. Your valuable silk, spice, and gem caravans cannot travel while lesser wolves roam the wilderness.
The adventurer is below Level 5 and is still too weak to survive the Ashen Fenrir's lair. They must train in the forest and cull lesser wolves first.
The adventurer has reached Level 5! The Forest Gate is now unsealed for them to enter the beast's lair and challenge the Ashen Fenrir.
The adventurer has slain the Ashen Fenrir! The siege on Oakhaven is lifted, livestock and trade routes are secure, and the entire village is celebrating.
